method: WebFetch of each official UCL course page (ucl.ac.uk/study/prospective-students/undergraduate/courses/<slug>) plus the UCL Undergraduate fees for 2027 to 2028 schedule page and fee-schedules index; suspicious pages re-fetched with cache-busting query strings. The schedule page embeds its overseas fee table in a script tool, so per-course overseas fees come from course pages only.

universityWideStatements.quote: UK undergraduate fees for 2027-28 entry are £10,050 and are for the first year only.
universityWideStatements.title: Undergraduate fees for 2027 to 2028 | Study at UCL
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: UK undergraduates, 2027-28 entry (no parliamentary-approval caveat on this page; course pages carry the caveat, so UK is recorded as awaiting-publication/indicative)

universityWideStatements.quote: Overseas fees shown below will be charged to 2027-28 entrants and are for the first year only.
universityWideStatements.title: Undergraduate fees for 2027 to 2028 | Study at UCL
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Overseas fees in the embedded fee tool (not rendered in fetched text); per-course figures taken from course pages

universityWideStatements.quote: UK undergraduate fees for 2027/28 are subject to parliamentary approval and are for the first year only.
universityWideStatements.title: Physics BSc | Study at UCL (same wording on all course pages)
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: UK fee caveat on course pages
